description:
Implement the `BchSpec` model types and the canonical construction path for the consecutive-root flavors: primitive narrow-sense and primitive with arbitrary first root, over any supported base field.

## Background

Construction derives the generator polynomial from coset minimal polynomials via the public polynomial LCM, dimension $k$, a witnessed classical BCH bound from the longest consecutive root run, and the correction radius that bound implies; it validates $\gcd(n,q)=1$, exact root order, base/splitting-field compatibility, and coefficient restriction, reporting failures through the layered error surface. Remaining flavors (seed sets, explicit generators, non-primitive conventions, degenerate codes) land in the follow-on flavor task on this same pipeline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `BchSpec` types exist per the approved design, and primitive consecutive-root specs construct through one path deriving generator, dimension, witnessed bound, and radius with the listed validations as typed errors.
- [hard] REQ-02: Binary primitive narrow-sense results agree with the current implementation's generator polynomials on representative parameters.
- [hard] REQ-03: Nonbinary primitive construction works over GF(p) and GF(p^r) bases with base-coefficient generators dividing $x^n-1$.
title: Implement BchSpec and the consecutive-root construction path
